_comment: PROVISIONAL. Not the M1.5 prototype finding ADR-006 asks for, and not
confirmed by Kihea's read of the two reading-screen registers in
apps/web (ADR-019, ADVISORY-002, ADVISORY-003). Values here are a first
real embodiment of ADR-019's two-register decision -- ink-and-paper
passage typography shared by both, a dark glass register and a paper
register for everything the passage sits inside -- derived from
interface-inspiration/vision.md by reasoning, never pasted from it
(ADR-019 Decision 4). Expect every value here to move once someone has
looked at both registers on a real screen with real text.
One file, both registers (ADR-019 Decision 4) -- consumed as CSS custom
properties by apps/web/scripts/tokens-to-css.mjs. Android and iOS read
this same file when a shell exists to hold it.

font.serif: 'Source Serif 4 Variable', ui-serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

page._comment: The passage's own paper surface -- shared verbatim by both registers, because law 3's typographic discipline governs the text column regardless of what register the surrounding chrome answers to (ADR-019 Decision 1).

paper._comment: Variant B. The whole reading state is the page -- chrome recedes to nothing, so there is no separate ground token here. Reads `page.light` or `page.dark` by the system's own colour-scheme preference.

glass._comment: Variant A. The page (a `page`-toned card) floats on this ground. Idle only while a passage is on screen -- no animated gradient, no shifting glow (ADR-019, ADVISORY-003).
